SELECT CASE d.dependency_kind
 WHEN 'source' THEN concat_ws('|','source',d.source_id,d.source_version_id,d.source_revision,d.original_sha256)
 WHEN 'event' THEN concat_ws('|','event',d.origin_activity_id,d.record_id,d.record_kind,d.origin_scope_revision,d.origin_goal_version,d.record_sha256)
 WHEN 'memory' THEN concat_ws('|','memory',d.upstream_memory_id,d.upstream_version,d.upstream_body_sha256) END

SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(coalesce(string_agg(public.memory_dependency_line(d),E'\n' ORDER BY ordinal),''),'UTF8')),'hex')
 FROM public.learning_memory_dependencies d WHERE d.memory_id=mid AND d.version=ver

SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(coalesce(string_agg(concat_ws('|',s.source_id,s.version_id,s.source_revision,v.sha256),
 E'\n' ORDER BY s.source_id),''),'UTF8')),'hex')
 FROM public.activity_scope_sources s JOIN public.material_versions v ON v.source_id=s.source_id AND v.id=s.version_id WHERE s.activity_id=aid

SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(coalesce(string_agg(concat_ws('|',memory_id,version,selected_revision,body_sha256),
 E'\n' ORDER BY ordinal),''),'UTF8')),'hex') FROM public.activity_memory_choices WHERE activity_id=aid

SELECT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM public.learning_memories h JOIN public.learning_memory_revisions r USING(memory_id)
 JOIN public.learning_memory_bodies b USING(memory_id,version)
 WHERE h.memory_id=mid AND r.version=ver AND h.state='active'
 AND r.body_sha256=encode(sha256(convert_to(b.body,'UTF8')),'hex') AND r.body_bytes=octet_length(b.body)
 AND r.dependency_count=(SELECT count(*) FROM public.learning_memory_dependencies WHERE memory_id=mid AND version=ver)
 AND r.dependencies_sha256=public.memory_dependency_digest(mid,ver)
 AND NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM public.learning_memory_dependencies d
 LEFT JOIN public.material_sources s ON s.id=d.source_id
 LEFT JOIN public.material_versions v ON v.source_id=d.source_id AND v.id=d.source_version_id
 WHERE d.memory_id=mid AND d.version=ver AND d.dependency_kind='source'
 AND(s.current_version IS DISTINCT FROM d.source_version_id OR s.revision IS DISTINCT FROM d.source_revision
 OR v.sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM d.original_sha256
 OR(v.format='pdf' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.pdf_review_candidates c WHERE c.version_id=v.id
 AND c.status='confirmed' AND c.page_count BETWEEN 1 AND 50
 AND(SELECT count(*) FROM public.pdf_review_pages p WHERE p.candidate_id=c.id)=c.page_count
 AND(SELECT count(*) FROM public.pdf_extracted_pages p WHERE p.version_id=c.version_id)=c.page_count))))
 AND NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM public.learning_memory_dependencies d LEFT JOIN public.teaching_records t
 ON t.activity_id=d.origin_activity_id AND t.record_id=d.record_id
 WHERE d.memory_id=mid AND d.version=ver AND d.dependency_kind='event'
 AND(t.kind IS DISTINCT FROM d.record_kind OR t.body_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM d.record_sha256
 OR t.scope_revision IS DISTINCT FROM d.origin_scope_revision OR t.goal_version IS DISTINCT FROM d.origin_goal_version
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.teaching_records x WHERE x.activity_id=t.activity_id
 AND((x.kind='correction' AND x.parent_record_id=t.record_id)
 OR(x.kind='answer' AND x.supersedes_record_id=t.record_id)
 OR(x.kind='feedback' AND t.kind IN ('feedback','progress') AND x.answer_record_id=t.answer_record_id AND x.seq>t.seq)))))
 AND NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM public.learning_memory_dependencies d
 LEFT JOIN public.learning_memories up ON up.memory_id=d.upstream_memory_id
 LEFT JOIN public.learning_memory_revisions ur ON ur.memory_id=d.upstream_memory_id AND ur.version=d.upstream_version
 LEFT JOIN public.learning_memory_bodies ub ON ub.memory_id=ur.memory_id AND ub.version=ur.version
 WHERE d.memory_id=mid AND d.version=ver AND d.dependency_kind='memory'
 AND(up.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'active' OR up.current_version IS DISTINCT FROM d.upstream_version
 OR ur.body_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM d.upstream_body_sha256 OR ub.body IS NULL
 OR encode(sha256(convert_to(ub.body,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM d.upstream_body_sha256
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.learning_memory_dependencies pd WHERE pd.memory_id=d.upstream_memory_id
 AND pd.version=d.upstream_version AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.learning_memory_dependencies cd
 WHERE cd.memory_id=mid AND cd.version=ver AND public.memory_dependency_line(cd)=public.memory_dependency_line(pd)))))
 )
SELECT public.memory_revision_readable(mid,ver) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.learning_memories WHERE memory_id=mid AND current_version=ver AND state='active')

SELECT (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.activity_memory_bindings WHERE activity_id=aid)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.activity_operation_results r WHERE r.activity_id=aid
  AND r.payload_format='json' AND r.payload::jsonb->'value'->>'profile'='teaching.v2')
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.teaching_commands c WHERE c.activity_id=aid
  AND c.context_body IS NOT NULL AND c.context_body::jsonb->>'schema'='teaching.context.v2')) OR EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM public.activity_memory_bindings b JOIN public.activities a ON a.id=b.activity_id
 WHERE b.activity_id=aid AND b.bound_scope_revision=a.scope_revision
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.activity_scope_sources WHERE activity_id=aid)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.activity_scope_sources sc LEFT JOIN public.material_sources ms ON ms.id=sc.source_id
 WHERE sc.activity_id=aid AND(ms.current_version IS DISTINCT FROM sc.version_id OR ms.revision IS DISTINCT FROM sc.source_revision))
 AND b.bound_scope_sha256=public.memory_scope_digest(aid) AND b.selection_sha256=public.memory_choice_digest(aid)
 AND b.selected_count=(SELECT count(*) FROM public.activity_memory_choices WHERE activity_id=aid)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.activity_memory_choices c JOIN public.learning_memories h USING(memory_id)
 WHERE c.activity_id=aid AND(h.revision<>c.selected_revision OR h.current_version<>c.version
 OR NOT public.memory_revision_eligible(c.memory_id,c.version)
 OR c.body_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM(SELECT body_sha256 FROM public.learning_memory_revisions WHERE memory_id=c.memory_id AND version=c.version)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.learning_memory_dependencies d WHERE d.memory_id=c.memory_id AND d.version=c.version
 AND d.dependency_kind='source' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.activity_scope_sources s
 WHERE s.activity_id=aid AND s.source_id=d.source_id AND s.version_id=d.source_version_id AND s.source_revision=d.source_revision))))
 )

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.interview_commands c JOIN public.interview_heads h USING(activity_id)
  JOIN public.interview_records ir ON ir.activity_id=c.activity_id AND ir.business_key=c.business_key AND ir.origin='model'
  JOIN public.activities a ON a.id=c.activity_id
  JOIN public.activity_operations o ON o.activity_id=c.activity_id AND o.operation_id=c.operation_id
  JOIN public.activity_operation_results r ON r.activity_id=o.activity_id AND r.operation_id=o.operation_id
 WHERE c.activity_id=aid AND c.operation_id=op AND c.duplicate_of IS NULL AND c.effect_applied AND c.status IN ('committed','history')
  AND NOT c.obsolete AND c.goal_version=h.goal_version AND c.scope_revision=h.scope_revision AND h.scope_revision=a.scope_revision
  AND a.status<>'cancelled' AND ir.operation_id=c.operation_id AND ir.payload_sha256=r.payload_sha256 AND ir.body_sha256=r.payload_sha256
  AND r.admission_id=o.admission_id AND r.execution_generation=o.execution_generation AND r.scope_revision=o.scope_revision AND o.state='received' AND o.kind='model'
  AND r.payload_format='json'
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.activity_scope_sources s LEFT JOIN public.material_sources m ON m.id=s.source_id
    WHERE s.activity_id=aid AND (m.id IS NULL OR m.current_version IS DISTINCT FROM s.version_id OR m.revision<>s.source_revision))
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.activity_scope_sources WHERE activity_id=aid)
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.activity_memory_bindings WHERE activity_id=aid))

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT a.status<>'cancelled' AND a.deadline_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  AND a.scope_revision=(frozen->>'scope_revision')::integer
  AND public.activity_memory_eligible(a.id)
  AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.activity_memory_bindings m WHERE m.activity_id=a.id)
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.activity_memory_bindings m WHERE m.activity_id=a.id
             AND m.selection_sha256=frozen->>'memory_selection_sha256'))
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.activity_scope_sources s WHERE s.activity_id=a.id)
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(frozen->'sources') ref WHERE NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM public.activity_scope_sources s JOIN public.material_sources m ON m.id=s.source_id
      JOIN public.material_versions v ON v.id=s.version_id AND v.source_id=s.source_id
     WHERE s.activity_id=a.id AND s.source_id::text=ref->>'source_id' AND s.version_id::text=ref->>'version_id'
      AND s.source_revision=(ref->>'source_revision')::integer AND m.current_version=s.version_id
      AND m.revision=s.source_revision AND v.sha256=ref->>'original_sha256'))
  AND jsonb_array_length(frozen->'sources')=(SELECT count(*) FROM public.activity_scope_sources s WHERE s.activity_id=a.id)
  AND CASE WHEN frozen->'parent'->>'kind'='learning' THEN EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM public.activity_operations o JOIN public.activity_operation_results r
     ON r.activity_id=o.activity_id AND r.operation_id=o.operation_id
    WHERE o.activity_id=a.id AND o.operation_id=frozen->'parent'->>'operation_id' AND o.kind='model'
     AND o.state='received' AND o.scope_revision=a.scope_revision AND r.payload_sha256=frozen->'parent'->>'payload_sha256'
     AND r.admission_id=o.admission_id AND r.execution_generation=o.execution_generation
     AND r.payload::jsonb->'value'->>'profile'='learning.v1' AND r.payload::jsonb->'value'->'result'->>'kind'='answer')
   ELSE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.teaching_heads h JOIN public.teaching_records r ON r.activity_id=h.activity_id
    WHERE h.activity_id=a.id AND r.record_id::text=frozen->'parent'->>'record_id'
     AND r.body_sha256=frozen->'parent'->>'body_sha256' AND r.goal_version=h.goal_version
     AND r.scope_revision=a.scope_revision AND (r.kind='exercise' AND r.record_id=h.exercise_record_id
       OR r.kind='feedback' AND r.record_id=h.feedback_record_id))
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(frozen->'dependencies') d WHERE NOT EXISTS(
      SELECT 1 FROM public.teaching_records r WHERE r.activity_id=a.id AND r.record_id::text=d->>'record_id'
       AND r.body_sha256=d->>'body_sha256' AND r.scope_revision=a.scope_revision)) END
 FROM public.activities a WHERE a.id=aid),false)

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT c.status='terminal' AND c.terminal_disposition='succeeded'
   AND o.kind='model' AND o.state='received' AND r.payload_sha256=b.body_sha256
   AND r.admission_id=o.admission_id AND r.execution_generation=o.execution_generation
   AND b.renderer_sha256=public.html_expected_renderer() AND c.renderer_sha256=b.renderer_sha256
   AND public.html_parent_eligible(aid,c.context_body::jsonb)
  FROM public.html_artifacts b JOIN public.html_commands c ON c.activity_id=b.activity_id AND c.business_key=b.business_key
   JOIN public.activity_operations o ON o.activity_id=b.activity_id AND o.operation_id=b.operation_id
   JOIN public.activity_operation_results r ON r.activity_id=b.activity_id AND r.operation_id=b.operation_id
  WHERE b.activity_id=aid AND b.artifact_id=art),false)
BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'html artifact immutable'; END;

BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'html sessions retained'; END IF;
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
  IF NEW.state<>'reserved' OR NEW.cid IS NOT NULL OR NEW.elapsed_seconds IS NOT NULL
   OR NOT public.html_artifact_eligible(NEW.activity_id,NEW.artifact_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'html start qualification'; END IF;
 ELSE
  IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['cid','state','elapsed_seconds','first_stop_receipt','confirmation_receipt','revision']) IS DISTINCT FROM
    (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['cid','state','elapsed_seconds','first_stop_receipt','confirmation_receipt','revision'])
    OR NEW.revision<>OLD.revision+1 OR (OLD.cid IS NOT NULL AND NEW.cid IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.cid)
    OR (OLD.first_stop_receipt IS NOT NULL AND NEW.first_stop_receipt IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.first_stop_receipt)
    OR (OLD.confirmation_receipt IS NOT NULL AND NEW.confirmation_receipt IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.confirmation_receipt)
    OR (OLD.elapsed_seconds IS NOT NULL AND NEW.elapsed_seconds IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.elapsed_seconds)
    OR OLD.state IN ('stopped','failed_unstarted')
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'html session identity immutable'; END IF;
  IF NEW.state<>OLD.state AND NOT(
   OLD.state='reserved' AND NEW.state IN ('registered','failed_unstarted','cleanup_unconfirmed')
   OR OLD.state='registered' AND NEW.state IN ('start_requested','failed_unstarted','cleanup_unconfirmed')
   OR OLD.state='start_requested' AND NEW.state IN ('ready','stopping','cleanup_unconfirmed')
   OR OLD.state='ready' AND NEW.state IN ('running','stopping','cleanup_unconfirmed')
   OR OLD.state='running' AND NEW.state IN ('stopping','cleanup_unconfirmed')
   OR OLD.state='stopping' AND NEW.state IN ('stopped','cleanup_unconfirmed')
   OR OLD.state='cleanup_unconfirmed' AND NEW.state IN ('stopped','failed_unstarted'))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'html session transition'; END IF;
  IF NEW.state IN ('stopped','failed_unstarted') AND (NEW.confirmation_receipt IS NULL
    OR COALESCE(NEW.confirmation_receipt::jsonb->>'tree_confirmation','') NOT IN ('private_pid_init_terminated','never_started'))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'html tree proof missing'; END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END;
